description: List the models this account can generate with, grouped by what they make (3D, image, …): each with its id, the scenes (input modes such as text-to-3d or image-to-3d) it supports, and the credits it costs at default options. Call this first to choose a model id, then estimate_cost for an exact price. Set include_inputs to also get the option fields of each scene (names, allowed values, ranges). An account whose app has Image Maker also gets presets: ready-made picture conversions (figurine, style, pose, …) to run with generate by passing options.preset. batches lists the scenes start_batch can run over several Library pictures at once, with the models each may use.

available_only.description: Leave out models that are listed but cannot be started.

include_inputs.description: Include the option fields of every scene (larger result).

media_type.description: Only models of this kind, e.g. '3d' or 'image'.

name: list_models

batches.description: Scenes start_batch can run over several pictures; empty when the app offers none.

max_items.description: Most pictures any plan may batch; list_batches gives the account’s own allowance.

available.description: False for a model that is listed but cannot be started yet.

credits_from.description: The cheapest scene at default options; options can raise it — use estimate_cost for the real figure.

family.description: The product line this model is a release of, e.g. 'meshy'; null for a model with no sibling releases. Every release is a model id you can pass to generate.

id.description: Pass as model to estimate_cost and the generate tools.
The key to use in options; the scene's prompt field goes in prompt.

kind.description: text, long-text, choice, number, toggle, count, seed, media (upload URLs), song, library, timeline, elements or hidden.

options.description: The allowed values of a choice; null for other kinds.

value_type.description: The JSON shape to send: string, number, boolean, string[], object or object[].

inputs.description: Option fields per scene; null unless include_inputs is true.

latest.description: True for a family's newest release (and for a model with no family). False marks an older release that a newer one replaced: pin it only to reproduce earlier work.

retires_at.description: The UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) the provider retires this model, when one is announced; null otherwise. After it, generate refuses the model.

version.description: This release's label within its family, e.g. 'v7.1'; null with family.

presets.description: Image presets this app offers; empty when it has none or media_type is not image.

addons.description: Ids for options.preset_addons; empty when the preset has none.

aspect_ratio.description: The frame the preset is tuned for; options.aspect_ratio overrides.

family.description: figurine, style, pose or convert: the kind of conversion.

id.description: Pass as options.preset to generate (mediaType 'image', scene 'image-to-image').

images.description: How many pictures a run takes in options.image: the subject first, then an optional reference.

instructions_max_length.description: prompt on a preset run is only your additional instructions, at most this long.

models.description: Image models it can run on in this account’s app.

title: List models and prices
